description: A link the user can open to start right away in the CutLuma editor with a tool or template ready. tool is one of: captions, record, resize, silence, shorts, product, testimonials, trim, text, music, montage, camera, voice, speed, tts, translate, greenscreen, cutout, prompter, stock, textvideo, magicdesign, aiimage, bgremove, magicedit, visualizer, charts, industry, effects, translatedesign, localize, transcript, dub, publish, present, open, subtitles, textbehind, tracking, subjectfx, colorchange, freezeintro, guide, hub, narration, agent, grade, mixer, multicam. language is a two-letter code for captions (e.g. "ar", "es"). With neither, a blank project opens.
name: make_editor_link
title: Build an editor link
